description: Figure 2 presents a nested pie chart illustrating the composition of the MULTITURNINSTRUCT dataset, categorized by different capabilities. The chart consists of an inner circle divided into three main segments and an outer ring divided into nine sub-segments. The inner circle contains text labels directly inside the slices: a red slice labeled "Contradiction Resolution," a dark blue slice labeled "Context Tracking," and a teal slice labeled "Context Retrieving." The outer ring contains nine slices, each colored in a lighter shade corresponding to its adjacent inner segment, with labels and raw numerical values connected by thin lines to the outside of the chart. Adjacent to the red inner slice are three light red outer slices: "Prioritization" (100), "Personalization" (100), and "Privacy Protection" (111). Adjacent to the dark blue inner slice are three light blue outer slices: "Triggering" (100), "Recursive Reasoning" (110), and "Dynamic Environment" (100). Adjacent to the teal inner slice are three light teal outer slices: "Memorization" (100), "Dynamic Instruction" (100), and "Multitasking" (160). The chart does not include a separate legend or percentage labels, relying instead on the external labels and numerical values. All segments are separated by thin white borders, and while most outer slices appear roughly equal in size, the "Multitasking" slice is visibly larger; however, the segments do not appear to be arranged in a strict ascending or descending order.
